channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Clarkson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Clarkson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Jordan Clarkson, Ron Holland
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:Cade Cunningham on Ron Holland's ejection after confronting Jordan Clarkson with fists up:

“That’s who Ron is. Ron is a super loyal dude, super tough-minded dude. I could’ve had my eyes closed and guessed who was going to be in the middle of it. That’s just who he is.”

Cade Cunningham on Jordan Clarkson, Ron Holland, Dec 19, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Will Hardy on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Will Hardy:

“Jordan with 38 points, but I'm honestly more proud of his 10 rebounds than his 38 points if I'm being honest with you.”

Will Hardy on Jordan Clarkson, Mar 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Will Hardy on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Will Hardy on what he told Jordan Clarkson before his triple-double:

“I said get a rebound and call time out immediately. I'mobviously not here to mess up a good time. I understand that I would've been maybe the most hated man in the building if I had subbed him out.”

Will Hardy on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 2, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Mitchell said with a slight grin.

“I saw a little bit of (Utah’s) game last night. (Jordan) Clarkson’s playing phenomenally. Obviously, Lauri Markennan, Lauri’s been this good but now I think he’s getting the opportunity to really flourish, and that’s great to see. We’re from the same draft class, I’ve known him for a little bit. A lot of guys look really good over there. I got some friends and staff on the team so it’d be great to see them all and, you know, play against them for the first time.”

Donovan Mitchell on Jordan Clarkson, Dec 17, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Chot Reyes on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Still reeling from a disappointing 9th place finish in the FIBA Asia Cup and a lackluster performance in the third window of the qualifiers, Gilas head coach and program director Chot Reyes bared that Clarkson, who last played for the country in the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta, Indonesia…

“We also have word that Jordan Clarkson is coming. Hoping to join the team as well to play on the 25th and the 29th (of August). Hopefully Kai Sotto can make it this time,”

Chot Reyes on Jordan Clarkson, Jul 20, 2022. Source: Tempo.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the off-court vibe brought by Jordan Clarkson:

“The word that comes to mind is authenticity.… He's one of those people that, when he walks in the door, your day gets better. He's got a magnetic personality.”

Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Jun 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson and Joe Ingles being the two betting favorites for Sixth an of the Year:

“I hope they both compete with each other for Defensive Player of the Year, although I don’t know if Rudy would accept that.”

Quin Snyder on Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Apr 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Mike Conley on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Mike Conley:

“I felt like I could play in every back-to-back, but that's why we have a staff — to protect me from myself.… But I told [the coaches] I was planning to play [vs. Portland] even before I knew Jordan was injured.”

Mike Conley on Jordan Clarkson, Apr 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson's struggles:

“I don't want to overreact to one or two games for any of our guys. We know who Jordan is, he's been terrific, and he's had far more games where he's made shots.”

Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on Jordan Clarkson's 6MOY chances:

“I think it should be unanimous. If the voting was today, I don’t see how you couldn’t vote for Jordan Clarkson.… It’s no debate. You look at the scoring, the impact, I don’t see no one else that has that impact for their team.”

Rudy Gobert on Jordan Clarkson, Mar 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff on Jordan Clarkson.

“Jordan is awesome, he is one of my favorites guys that I've been around. Just as a person and a competittor, his game is enjoyable to watch. It's different but it's efficient and he can score in so many different ways.”

JB Bickerstaff on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley
item.description:
“I was really excited about the chemistry that we were getting with our second unit that Quin had found with Mike Conley, Jordan Clarkson, Joe Ingles, Georges Niang and Tony Bradley,”

Dennis Lindsey on Mike Conley, Joe Ingles, Jordan Clarkson, Georges Niang, Tony Bradley, May 8, 2020. Source: deseret.com.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on Jordan Clarkson’s fit:

“I love him. I love him. Write it down — I love him. Sometimes a system needs to be malleable. ... I want him to be instinctive.... The opportunity to continue to get better is there for him offensively, which is a heck of a statement.”

Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 31, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Walden:Donovan Mitchell, on new teammate Jordan Clarkson:

“He’s a tough cover. He can get you a bucket on three different levels.”

Donovan Mitchell on Jordan Clarkson, Dec 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Dante Exum
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Dante Exum-Jordan Clarkson trade:

“You have to give something up to get something. Dante is someone we thought a lot of as a player and as a person. But at the same time, we’re excited about Jordan.”

Quin Snyder on Jordan Clarkson, Dante Exum, Dec 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Kyle Kuzma on blockbuster trade:

“It was really unfortunate, for me especially. I was really close to Larry [Nance Jr.] & JC [Jordan Clarkson].Those two guys I kind of clicked with right away. We all miss them for sure but at the end of the day, it’s a business.”

Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Clarkson, Feb 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeff Hornacek on Julius Randle, Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Jeff Hornacek:

“[Julius] Randle & [Jordan] Clarkson, they were killing us. We tried multiple guys on both of them but they took it to whoever was guarding them. That was a big key, we couldn’t get any stops.”

Jeff Hornacek on Julius Randle, Jordan Clarkson, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Clarkson’s scoring:

“I don’t know, but whatever he’s doing he should keep doing it.”

Kyle Kuzma on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson:

“He is obviously a very gifted offensive player & I think he is feeling good about himself right now.”

Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Mark Medina:D'Angelo on Luke not starting him w/ Clarkson:

“It’s great. I hope he’s doing what he expects. But it is what it is.”

D'Angelo Russell on Jordan Clarkson, Mar 15, 2017. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Bob Garcia:Magic Johnson:

“I think Jordan Clarkson can be one of the best defensive players in the league.”

Magic Johnson on Jordan Clarkson, Feb 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @bgarcia90.

item.title: Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson:

“I told him I think he can be a phenomenal defender in this league.”

Luke Walton on Jordan Clarkson, Oct 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
“Jordan is an important piece of our young core and resigning him was a priority of our offseason,”

Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Clarkson, Jul 7, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
Eric Pincus:Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Clarkson upcoming RFA:

“It's going to be virtually impossible for Jordan Clarkson to leave us”

Mitch Kupchak on Jordan Clarkson, Jan 3, 2016. Source: Twitter @EricPincus.

item.title: Gary Vitti on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
“He was asking about our young kids, and I said, 'You cannot believe how quick and athletic Jordan Clarkson is. He looks fantastic,'”

Gary Vitti on Jordan Clarkson, Jul 27, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Byron Scott on Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
“I’m sure he has very high expectations of himself, but, again, I've got to take it step-by-step. “He’s had a great rookie year. Let’s see how the summer goes and training camp goes, and let’s see how the season goes next year. I want to keep everything in perspective when it comes to Jordan Clarkson. Obviously, he’s shown that he can play in this league.”

Byron Scott on Jordan Clarkson, Apr 2, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Byron Scott on Steve Nash, Jordan Clarkson
item.description:
“I would still like for him to come around. If for nothing else, to talk to Jordan Clarkson and help him and tutor him a little bit. But as we’ve been talking all season long, (Nash) has to feel OK about that.”

Byron Scott on Steve Nash, Jordan Clarkson, Jan 20, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Daily News.
